title: Larry Susskind on Kurt Jaimungal's podcast calls string theory a failure

tellings.quote: Larry uh Larry Suskin just went on Kirch Mungle's podcast and basically It was quite shocking to hear this guy uh you know leading light of string theory guy you know getting towards the end of his career. He's just like yeah it was complete fail failure. It's basically pointless. Everyone should start over.

plain: Leonard Susskind, a physicist and leading figure of string theory (the idea that the basic bits of matter are tiny vibrating strings), went on the physics podcast of Curt Jaimungal near the end of his career and said string theory had been a complete failure, "basically pointless", and that "everyone should start over". The analyst Matthew Pines tells Michels this, calling it "quite shocking" to hear. If so, one of the field's own founders was admitting that physics' leading theory had stalled.
